facts.fact: Xalam Analytics estimates roughly 8-10 live commercial (colocation for third parties) data centre facilities in Ghana in 2025, with about 6.5 MW live critical IT load and about 80% of supply carrier-neutral; it names Equinix, Digital Realty, PAIX, ADC and MTN as active in Ghana but gives no per-facility opening dates.

note: Brief states no Tier III/IV facility and no cloud region for Ghana; about 2 facilities in construction or pipeline and 5 MW in construction are not facts.
